title: M PAT (Provable Acceptance Test)
description: Schema for story-level and sub-task-level PAT.yaml files. Story PATs define the full acceptance contract for a user story. Sub-task PATs scope acceptance criteria to what is verifiable in isolation for a single component.

oneOf.description: Story-level PAT — lives in root repo at pats/<story-id>.pat.yaml
Sub-task PAT — lives in managed repo at pats/<sub-task-id>.pat.yaml

story.description: Story identifier (e.g. TODOM-001, PROJ-042). Present on story-level PATs only.

sub-task.description: Sub-task identifier (e.g. TODOM-001c). Story ID + alphabetic suffix. Present on sub-task PATs only.

parent-story.description: Parent story identifier. Required on sub-task PATs.

component.description: Component name from project.yaml (e.g. todo-m-mfe). Required on sub-task PATs.

acceptance.description: Ordered list of acceptance criteria. Order matters — later entries may depend on state created by earlier ones.

id.description: Unique within this PAT file. Format: AC-NNN for single criteria, AC-NNNx (a,b,c...) when one acceptance criterion yields multiple test scenarios.

when.description: Trigger condition in plain English. User-facing, topology-agnostic. No component names, API paths, or CSS selectors.

then.description: Expected outcome in plain English. Observable result from the user's perspective.

steps.description: Ordered test steps. Each step is an object with exactly one verb key. Steps map directly to Cypress commands for story-level PATs.

replaces.description: AC this supersedes, from a previous story. Format: <story-id>/AC-<id>. Compiler must find and update the old compiled test.

removes.description: AC this deletes, from a previous story. Format: <story-id>/AC-<id>. Compiler must find and delete the old compiled test.

step.description: A single test step. Exactly one verb key per step object.

step-navigate.description: Navigate to a URL path. Compiles to cy.visit(path).

step-click.description: Click an element by data-testid selector. Format: "[data-testid='<id>']". Compiles to cy.get(selector).click().

step-type.description: Type text into an element. Format: "[data-testid='<id>']" value "<text>". Compiles to cy.get(selector).type(text).

step-assert.description: Assert a condition on an element. Formats: "[selector]" is visible | "[selector]" contains "<value>" | "[selector]" count > N | "[selector]" is disabled.

step-wait.description: Wait for a condition on an element. Same formats as assert but waits with retry. Compiles to cy.get(selector).should(...).

step-render.description: Render a component with a mock setup. Sub-task PATs only (not browser-level). Not compiled to Cypress — used for component-level testing.
